data.name: जगदीश
data.gender_notes: जगदीश is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: जगत् (jagat) meaning the universe and ईश (Ish) meaning god or ruler, thus जगदीश (Jagadish) means the lord of the universe. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Lord Vishnu who is believed to rule and protect the universe. The name जगदीश carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose जगदीश usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying divine protection and rule over the universe.
data.etymology: जगदीश belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of जगदीश total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
